suction_outliers.note: Cp has no hard lower bound (potential flow over a cylinder reaches -3), so this is a mesh-degeneracy signal, not a bound violation.

cp.caveat: Reported physical maximum Cp 1.119 exceeds the incompressible stagnation bound of 1 on 1 of 44032 wall faces (0.002%). Values above the bound are degenerate sliver cells, a mesh quality defect, not a physical pressure. The highest bound-respecting value on this body is Cp 0.993. Present either the robust colour window with this disclosed, or the raw extreme with this caveat attached.
